scope: Built editor, isolated persistence/IndexedDB and synthetic writing. No live private writing or AI calls.
results: Grouped menus use shared entrance/exit timing; Escape and immediate reversal preserve selection, view, canvas width, content and word credit
Find, outline and portaled dialogs have restrained surface cues, immediate close/focus return, and no document transactions
Retained paper reveals once per document; typing/saves/Focus never replay it, and Focus from an open menu restores writing input and one-key Escape
Save feedback remains truthful through held persistence, offline edits, failed sync and retry; tone/halo never manufactures Saved
Reduced motion disables new surface motion and control transitions, including preference changes while a menu is open
Animated controls fit desktop/tablet/mobile down to 320px and pass axe WCAG 2/2.1 AA checks
